decision.question: Should SentinAgro be formally paused to reduce cognitive load?
decision.recommendation: Yes. SentinAgro has no revenue path, no MVP, no pilots, and no near-term funding angle. It's consuming planning cycles (feasibility study, pitch deck, market research all produced) with zero ROI. Formally parking it frees mental bandwidth.
evidence: SentinAgro: 0 revenue, 0 pilots, 0 customers, no MVP
4 VDR documents produced for SentinAgro — effort with no return
ZenithCred is the clear funding priority and needs more attention
Otto is a solo operator — every project competes for the same hours

options.label: Formally pause
options.description: Archive SentinAgro materials. Revisit after ZenithCred seed closes.

options.label: Keep on backburner
options.description: No active work but don't formally archive. Risk: keeps creeping into planning.

options.label: Kill entirely
options.description: Remove from portfolio. Reclaim the mental space permanently.
